annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires a client to treat any receipt of a Push ID that has already appeared in a prior PUSH_PROMISE frame as a connection error of type HTTP_ID_ERROR. The preceding clause establishes that a server must not reuse Push IDs, so the client can rely on uniqueness and the error condition is clearly defined.
